name: fastproxy
description: Manage Linux nftables TCP/UDP port forwarding from a web panel and terminal menu

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build:test -w apps/server && node --test apps/server/dist-test/test/*.test.js
